content.text: {"annotations":[{"start":4,"end":37,"text":"Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy","entity":"Modifier","rationale":"The disease name directly premodifies the molecular-entity head 'protein' (emerin is a protein), so only the disease tokens are annotated and the head noun stays outside the span.","guideline_section":"Section 3: Modifier - disease terms premodifying molecular or biological-entity heads"},{"start":693,"end":726,"text":"Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy","entity":"SpecificDisease","rationale":"Proper eponymic disease name serving as the standalone referent of a patient's condition (muscle biopsy from an affected patient); it is defined with an acronym in parentheses, so the long form is a Specific Disease.","guideline_section":"Section 1: Specific Disease; Section 6: Synonymous mentions"},{"start":729,"end":733,"text":"EMDM","entity":"SpecificDisease","rationale":"Acronym defined in parentheses that is the standalone referent of the disease, annotated as a separate synonymous mention from the long form.","guideline_section":"Section 3 negative constraint (a) and Section 6: Synonymous mentions"},{"start":760,"end":777,"text":"absence of emerin","entity":"SpecificDisease","rationale":"State nominal (absence) governing one defined biological component (emerin) that fills the disease-defining slot as the complement of the diagnostic predicate 'showed' attributing the finding to the patient's biopsy; no consequence frame applies. The modifier 'complete' and the method phrase stay outside the span.","guideline_section":"Section 1: Disorder-denoting state or finding nominals in a disease-defining slot; Section 5 (state-nominal span)"},{"start":879,"end":883,"text":"EDMD","entity":"Modifier","rationale":"Disease acronym directly premodifies the clinical head 'families'; because the head is clinical, the ordinary Modifier rule applies rather than Specific Disease.","guideline_section":"Section 3: Modifier - negative constraint (b), clinical or epidemiological head noun"}]}
